title: Masterbuilt AutoIgnite 545 Digital Charcoal Grill and Smoker Combo for Easy Grilling, Digital Control, App, Sear Plate, Mini Hopper and 545 BBQ Cooking Square In. in Black
features: CONVENIENCE OF GAS WITH THE FLAVOR OF CHARCOAL: QuickStart Automatic Ignition lights your fire starter with the push of a button. While other charcoal grills require lighter fluid, this smoker grill combo just a tap for great barbeque

DIGITAL CHARCOAL SMOKER GRILL - Set your desired cooking temperature on the digital control panel or the Masterbuilt app and the DigitalFan effortlessly maintains your desired cooking temperature for you

VERSATILE BARBECUE GRILL – The AutoIgnite smart charcoal grill has a cook space of 545 square inches along with precision control temperature ranges from 250° - 650°F. Perfect for low-and-slow smoking or high-heat searing
EASY CHARCOAL GRILL - This grill smoker combo has an internal charcoal MiniHopper that holds 5lbs of lump charcoal or 7lbs of briquettes for up to 8 hours of use
